title: Incomplete list of disallowed inputs in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized… (CVE-2026-96196)
description: CVE-2026-96196 is a high-severity vulnerability in the Chromium-based Microsoft Edge browser caused by an incomplete list of disallowed inputs. This flaw allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature remotely over a network, potentially leading to full compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 8.8, indicating a serious risk. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
